:::{#rem-finite-not-countable-converse}
#### Finite additivity does not imply countable additivity

@exm-finite-not-countable shows that the [converse](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-converse) of @thm-countable-implies-finite fails,
even when $\measure(\emptyset) = 0$:
a finitely additive function need not be countably additive
[@wikipedia_sigma_additive_set_function].
The function $\measure$ in @exm-finite-not-countable has $\measure(\emptyset) = 0$,
because $\emptyset$ is finite.

:::
